headline: Turkmenistan Approves State Budget for 2027 at $39.5 Billion
summary: Turkmenistan approved its state budget for 2027, setting total revenues and expenditures at 138.1 billion manat ($39.5 billion).
why: National budget allocations indicate government spending priorities, fiscal targets, and public investment plans in emerging economies.
